budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Agricultural Commission was awarded a grant to pay for the signs.

budget_items.topic: Firefighter contract outside detail and town detail rates
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The outside private detail rate rises and the Town detail rate is set.
budget_items.quote: the outside private detail rate will be increased from $35.00 to $42.00/hr., the town detail rate will be $36.00/hour

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wage increases are within the Board's authorization of a 1.5% increase per year.
budget_items.quote: both parties reached agreement within the board of selectmen's authorization of a 1.5%

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The EMT stipend increases from 3% to 5% for those who achieve Advanced Certification.
budget_items.quote: an increase from 3% to 5% in the emt stipend will be awarded to those

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Council on Aging received a grant award for the Are You Okay? Program.
The Conservation Commission started fining a property owner for work in the buffer zone without a Notice of Intent.
budget_items.quote: without a notice of intent at $100 per day.

budget_items.quote: they were also looking at the cost of notifying abutters via certified mail.
